reviewType: independent static source review; source parsed without execution

resolvedFindings.resolution: Execute holds a target-specific nonblocking root-owned O_NOFOLLOW flock. Failure cleanup requires successful exclusive creation and an activation attempt, and then verifies no symlink, dev/inode identity, complete unit text and loaded FragmentPath before stopping.
Target lexists checks reject dangling links, and LoadState=not-found is required both at preflight and immediately before persistent writes.

retainedChecks: Secret remains in memory/root-only configuration and subprocess output is captured, with only sanitized failures reported.
Generated FRPC configuration adds exactly one target proxy and a distinct FRPC user.
DynamicUser uses LoadCredential rather than an argv secret or a world-readable token file.
Existing service PIDs, states and protected configuration hashes remain compared before and after activation.
Default preparation does not mutate persistent target configuration or start/stop services.
verificationBoundary: Static review does not execute the installer or independently certify runtime activation.
A service active for two seconds does not establish public forwarding; independent 59527 strict host-key comparison remains necessary.
The execution lock serializes cooperating invocations; it does not constrain unrelated privileged administrative tools.
